This is an **"Add Record" form** in Alibaba Cloud DNS (as indicated by the title "Add Record" at the top). Here’s a detailed breakdown of the visible fields, dropdowns, and filled values:  


### 1. Form Title & Header  
- Title: *"Add Record"* (confirms it is an "Add Record" form).  
- Close button: An "X" icon in the top-right corner to close the form.  


### 2. Record Type (Dropdown)  
- Label: *"Record Type"*  
- Dropdown: Open (shows the selected option).  
- Selected value: *"CNAME"* (with a description: *"Points the domain name to another domain name"*).  


### 3. Hostname (Text Field)  
- Label: *"* Hostname"* (required field, marked with `*`).  
- Filled value: *"mail"*  
- Domain context: The domain is *"decodex-bolivia.net"* (displayed to the right of the field, indicating the record belongs to this domain).  


### 4. Query Source (Dropdown)  
- Label: *"* Query Source"* (required field, marked with `*`).  
- Dropdown: Open (shows the selected option).  
- Selected value: *"Default / Default"*.  


### 5. TTL (Time-to-Live) Section  
- Label: *"TTL | Record Value Load Balancing Policy (Default Value)"* (with a dropdown arrow to expand/collapse).  
- TTL field:  
  - Label: *"TTL"* (with a help icon `ⓘ`).  
  - Filled value: *"10 (Recommendation)"* (a recommended TTL value).  
  - Unit dropdown: Open, showing *"Minutes"* (selected unit for TTL).  


### 6. Record Value Load Balancing Policy (Dropdown)  
- Label: *"Record Value Load Balancing Policy"* (with a help icon `ⓘ`).  
- Dropdown: Open (shows the selected option).  
- Selected value: *"Ratio"* (a load balancing policy type).  


### 7. Record Values (Table)  
A table with columns: *"Record Value"*, *"Weight"*, *"Status"*, *"Remarks"*, *"Actions"*.  
- **Row 1 (only visible row)**:  
  - Record Value: *"decodex-bolivia-net.brand.brevosend.com"* (the CNAME target domain).  
  - Weight: *"1"* (numeric value for load balancing).  
  - Status: A green toggle switch (enabled, indicating the record is active).  
  - Remarks: Placeholder text *"Enter a description"* (empty, no description filled).  
  - Actions: *"0/50"* (likely a limit for entries) and a *"Delete"* button (to remove the row).  
- **Add Entry button**: A blue "+" button to add more record values (e.g., for multi-value load balancing).  


### 8. Health Check Section  
- Label: *"Health Check"* (with a help icon `ⓘ`).  
- Toggle switch: Green (enabled, indicating health check is active).  
- Options: *"Anomaly Detection"*, *"Automatic Alert"*, *"Switchover"* (features related to health check, all visible but not selected via checkboxes—likely part of the health check configuration).  


### 9. Action Buttons (Bottom)  
- *"OK"*: Blue button (to save the record).  
- *"Add and Continue"*: Blue button (to save and open another "Add Record" form).  
- *"Cancel"*: Button (to discard changes and close the form).  


### Summary  
This is an **"Add Record" form** for creating a **CNAME record** in Alibaba Cloud DNS. Key details:  
- Record type: CNAME (points to another domain).  
- Hostname: `mail` (for the domain `decodex-bolivia.net`).  
- Query source: Default.  
- TTL: 10 minutes (recommended).  
- Load balancing policy: Ratio.  
- Record value: `decodex-bolivia-net.brand.brevosend.com` (with weight 1, status enabled).  
- Health check: Enabled (with anomaly detection, automatic alert, and switchover options).  

All required fields (marked with `*`) are filled, and the form is ready for submission (via "OK" or "Add and Continue").
